verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of native time logging (worklogs) against Jira issues or projects. The only time-tracking reference is Tempo Timesheets, a third-party Marketplace app, which is an add-on rather than Jira's own capability. Capacity management and cycle-time metrics are adjacent features and do not show engineers logging time.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects
